test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. His role also includes the smooth flow of goods from farms and factories to the consumer.

B. As the final link between the producer and the consumer, he plays a key role in the economy.

C. It is he who promotes or impedes the sale of products.

D. The retailer determines the final cost of a product.
solution:
The correct answer is '**DCBA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence D** will be the first sentence because it is an independent general statement telling us about the cost of a product.
 
• **Sentence C** will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the next sentence because it is talking about the retailer who plays an important link between the producer and the consumer.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence A** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **D**: The retailer determines the final cost of a product.
 
• **C**: It is he who promotes or impedes the sale of products.
 
• **B**: As the final link between the producer and the consumer, he plays a key role in the economy.
 
• **A**: His role also includes the smooth flow of goods from farms and factories to the consumer.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *The retailer determines the final cost of a product. It is he who promotes or impedes the sale of products. As the final link between the producer and the consumer, he plays a key role in the economy. His role also includes the smooth flow of goods from farms and factories to the consumer.*
